_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: InspIRCd
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A modular IRC server. Runs plain IRC on the server's port, with an admin operator whose password you set.
startup: export CLOAK_KEY="$(cat data/cloak-key)"; [ -n "${OPER_PASSWORD:-}" ] || export OPER_PASSWORD="$(head -c 24 /dev/urandom | base64)"; exec ./bin/inspircd --nofork --nopid --config conf/inspircd.conf

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# InspIRCd: downloads the chosen release's Debian 13 package from GitHub
# (checked against GitHub's checksum) and unpacks its program and modules
# into the server's folder, then writes a first configuration. The settings
# (conf/), the MOTD and the data folder are never touched; the program and
# modules are replaced only once the new ones have been unpacked.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "InspIRCd publishes builds for x86-64 CPUs only, and this server's CPU is $(uname -m)."

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag inspircd/inspircd "$tag") || fail "InspIRCd has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 4.12.1, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
deb=$(gh-release assets inspircd/inspircd "$tag" | awk '!f && $1 ~ /\.deb13u[0-9]+_amd64\.deb$/ { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$deb" ] || fail "InspIRCd $version has no Debian 13 package, so it can't be installed here. Choose version 4.10.0 or newer."

if [ -x bin/inspircd ] && [ "$(cat .inspircd-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "InspIRCd $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading InspIRCd $version"
    gh-release download inspircd/inspircd "$tag" "$deb" "$work/inspircd.deb"
    dpkg-deb -x "$work/inspircd.deb" "$work/x"
    [ -x "$work/x/usr/bin/inspircd" ] || fail "The download isn't InspIRCd's package. Reinstall to try again."
    # Modules for databases and libraries the runtime image doesn't have.
    rm -f "$work"/x/usr/lib/inspircd/m_{argon2,log_json,mysql,pgsql,regex_re2}.so
    mkdir -p bin
    rm -rf modules.old
    [ ! -d modules ] || mv modules modules.old
    mv "$work/x/usr/lib/inspircd" modules
    rm -rf modules.old
    mv -f "$work/x/usr/bin/inspircd" bin/inspircd
    rm -rf examples
    mv "$work/x/usr/share/doc/inspircd/examples" examples
    echo "$version" > .inspircd-version
fi

mkdir -p conf data logs
[ -f conf/motd.txt ] || printf 'Welcome to %s.\n' "${NETWORK_NAME:-IRC}" > conf/motd.txt
[ -f conf/help.conf ] || cp examples/help.example.conf conf/help.conf
if [ ! -f conf/inspircd.conf ]; then
    cat > conf/inspircd.conf <<'CONF'
# InspIRCd's settings: https://docs.inspircd.org/4/configuration/
# The examples folder has every option. The network name, server name and
# operator password come from the server's settings in the Panel.
<path configdir="conf" datadir="data" logdir="logs" moduledir="modules">

<server name="&env.SERVER_HOSTNAME;"
        description="&env.NETWORK_NAME; IRC server"
        network="&env.NETWORK_NAME;">

<admin name="Admin" description="The network's administrator" email="noreply@example.com">

# Raptor sets the next line to the server's port at every start. Add other
# <bind> lines for more ports (TLS needs the ssl_gnutls module).
<bind address="" port="6667" type="clients">

<connect name="main"
         allow="*"
         maxchans="20"
         timeout="20"
         pingfreq="120"
         hardsendq="1M"
         softsendq="10240"
         recvq="10240"
         threshold="10"
         commandrate="1000"
         fakelag="yes"
         localmax="5"
         globalmax="5"
         resolvehostnames="yes"
         useident="no"
         limit="5000"
         modes="+x">

<files motd="motd.txt">

<log method="stdout" level="normal" type="* -USERINPUT -USEROUTPUT -MODULE">
<maxlist mode="ban" limit="100">

<class name="Everything" commands="*" privs="*" usermodes="*" chanmodes="*" snomasks="*">
<type name="NetAdmin" classes="Everything" vhost="netadmin.&env.SERVER_HOSTNAME;">

# The admin operator: /OPER admin <Operator password>. With no Operator
# password set, the startup gives it a random one nobody knows.
<oper name="admin" password="&env.OPER_PASSWORD;" host="*@*" type="NetAdmin">

<options prefixquit="Quit: " suffixquit="" fixedquit="" syntaxhints="yes" announcets="yes" hostintopic="yes" defaultmodes="not" xlinemessage="You're banned from this server.">
<security announceinvites="dynamic" hideservices="no" hidesplits="no" hideulinekills="no" maxtargets="5" customversion="" restrictbannedusers="yes" genericoper="no" userstats="Pu">
<performance netbuffersize="10240" somaxconn="128" softlimit="12800" clonesonconnect="yes" timeskipwarn="2s" quietbursts="yes">
<whowas groupsize="10" maxgroups="100000" maxkeep="3d">

<module name="cloak_sha256">
<cloak method="hmac-sha256" key="&env.CLOAK_KEY;" prefix="&env.NETWORK_NAME;-">
<module name="sha2">
<module name="help">
<include file="/home/container/conf/help.conf">
CONF
    echo "Wrote a first conf/inspircd.conf (plain IRC on the server's port)."
fi
# The cloaking key that hides users' addresses, made here once.
if [ ! -s data/cloak-key ]; then
    head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '\n/+=' > data/cloak-key
    chmod 600 data/cloak-key
fi
echo "Installed InspIRCd $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The InspIRCd version to install, such as 4.12.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Network name
variables.description: The network's name, shown to people when they connect.

variables.name: Server hostname
variables.description: The server's name on the network, a hostname such as irc.example.com.

variables.name: Operator password
variables.description: The password for the admin operator, used with /OPER admin <password>. Leave it empty to have no usable operator.
